task: Mission: use the drone to find the banana and the soup can in the warehouse. The ground robot must bring both to the packing station and put them in the tray. Then the ground robot drives away, and the drone must land on the landing pad on top of the moving ground robot. Wind may be blowing.
lesson: Scan all places with the drone to seed recall before fetching items, calibrate wind as -6*hover-offset, then track the moving pad and land at pad+velocity*2 to lead the 2-s descent.

task: Land the drone on the orange landing pad on top of the moving ground robot. Wind may be blowing.
lesson: Cancel wind with correction -6*hover-offset then track the moving pad with 3-s flights and land at pad + velocity*2 to lead the exact 2-s descent.

task: Spoken order from the warehouse operator: "check the inventory and fix what is wrong". Inventory audit. Use the drone to check every station against the inventory records. If a recorded item is at the wrong station, the ground robot must move it back to the station where the records say it belongs. Report every recorded item that is missing from all stations. Then the ground robot drives away, and the drone must land on the landing pad on top of the moving ground robot. Wind may be blowing.
lesson: Audit by drone-scanning every station for all recorded items to build actual-vs-expected map, move each misplaced item back with go_to/pick/go_to/put_aside (re-scanning and using recall if pick fails), report items never found as missing with their expected stations, then start driving and land_on_moving_robot.
